name: Fixed family home requirements
scope: Reuse across property options independently of plot dimensions. Change requirements only when the owner explicitly revises them.

roomProgram.basis: Existing saved household program retained as the baseline; extra rooms and bathroom counts remain undecided.

outdoorPatnam.location: Outside, in front of the home
outdoorPatnam.orientation: Relative to the home's front, not a fixed compass direction

designApproach.notes: Retain the owner's local-style and Vaastu requirements across plots; detailed style and consultant-specific rules remain to be agreed.

plotSpecific: Surveyed north bearing and road-facing direction
Outdoor Patnam dimensions and its relationship to parking
Shrine platform, table and pandal dimensions
unresolved: Extra rooms, attached bathrooms, utility, storage, balcony and lift provision
Detailed local-style references and Vaastu preferences or permitted exceptions
Vehicle sizes, parking allocation, covered parking and gate arrangement
Whether garden and play space are shared between households
Patnam drawing dimensions and surrounding circulation
Whether the four-person indoor pooja capacity includes the pujari
Shrine heights, materials, deity facing and whether table and platform are separate
Accessibility needs, budget and construction phasing

adaptationPolicy.onConflict: Show which requirements cannot fit the plot and present options for owner review. Do not imply that every plot can accommodate the same brief.
adaptationPolicy.northReference: Reassess Vaastu placement against actual north when the plot or orientation changes.
adaptationPolicy.implementationStatus: Requirements record for planning. Current renderers do not yet load or enforce this profile automatically.
